description: An oil-painted scene of a dim underground station. Commuters in jackets, shirts and trousers stand on a wet tiled platform, some boarding a red-and-blue train whose doors are open and windows glow. A dark stone column is on the left, stairs lead up in the background, and a framed painting of a city skyline with a tall pearl-shaped tower hangs on the station wall above the tracks. There is no visible text other than a small exit sign with no legible letters.
